-115.09800,36.03490.name: Green Valley Fertility Partners
-115.09800,36.03490.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Jeffrey D. Fisch, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-122.43833,47.24550.name: Madigan Army Medical Center
-122.43833,47.24550.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Defense Health Agency. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-2.21776,53.45854.name: Care Fertility Manchester
-2.21776,53.45854.state: 108 -112, Daisy Bank Road, Victoria Park, Manchester, M14 5QH, United Kingdom
-2.21776,53.45854.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-78.28938,44.35729.name: Trent University
-78.28938,44.35729.status: Certificate of GAP Last visit: regular, September 2026
-78.28938,44.35729.desc: An institution certified by the Canadian Council on Animal Care for its use of animals in science. Certificate of GAP Last visit: regular, September 2026. CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

9.96487,53.54677.name: Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine (BNI)
9.96487,53.54677.company: Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg
9.96487,53.54677.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, operational. Run by Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. Personnel work in full-body positive-pressure suits with their own air supply. Containment space: 150 SqM. Operational or announced: 2014. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-1.22400,51.71800.name: Oxford Biomedica
-1.22400,51.71800.desc: Manufactures the viral vectors that gene therapies are delivered in, for clients rather than under its own name. Delivery, not editing, is the real constraint on genetic medicine, so a handful of contract manufacturers effectively decide which therapies can be made at all — and during a shortage, which get made first is a commercial negotiation nobody appoints or oversees.

-95.55600,42.74110.name: Trans Ova Genetics
-95.55600,42.74110.desc: The largest bovine embryo transfer and cloning company in the United States, producing cloned cattle commercially since the 1990s. Cloned livestock and their descendants entered the food supply years ago with no labelling requirement, the argument about whether the public would accept it was resolved by not asking.

-67.08370,46.13510.name: J.R. Simplot / McCain — processor specification
-67.08370,46.13510.desc: The two largest potato processors, whose purchasing specifications decide which varieties are grown across North America. Simplot developed and sells its own engineered Innate potatoes, so the same company breeds the variety, commercialises it and buys the crop. What actually limited their spread was McDonald's declining to use them — a buyer decision doing what no regulator did.

-71.05700,42.36200.name: Emulate / organ-on-chip
-71.05700,42.36200.desc: Microfluidic devices lined with human cells that reproduce organ-level responses, as an alternative to animal testing. The law now permits non-animal methods and regulators still expect animal data, so the constraint stopped being legal and became conventional.
